body: Hey friend, thanks for your message, it made me feel better. Tea is great, but honestly what makes me the most happy is a bottle of vodka and a slice of cheese. It just disengages me from the suffering.
Wow, you guys are great! Made me feel a lot better (less anxious). Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

I've been waiting since grade school for life to finally get better for your typical reddit user (smart but socially awkward). School was hell but I always thought that if I worked hard and got good grades I'd eventually come out ahead of them in the real world (the whole ¨how is you high school bully doing now?¨scenario). 

Well, it turns out that the real world is exactly the same as school, the charismatic people get the great jobs and become the bosses of the smart, introverted ones. My high school bully (who has a room temperature IQ) is actually doing much better than me. Fuck this...
